description: Read one order in full by its id. Read-only. Returns { found: false, orderId } when there is no such order, otherwise found: true and the order. Money is in minor units of the order's currency: subtotal, discount, shippingTotal, tax, total, removedTax (VAT taken out of gross-stored prices on a reverse_charge, exempt or export order, else 0) and amounts (net, tax and gross of subtotal, discount, shipping and total). amountPaid is what was collected; balanceDue = total - amountPaid, and a refund does not change it; refundedAmount is refunded so far, so amountPaid - refundedAmount is left to refund; refundReferences lists the refund references already recorded. Frozen at checkout: displayMode (net or gross, how the buyer read prices), taxRoundingMethod (per_line or per_rate), taxTreatment (kind standard, reverse_charge, exempt or export, with legalNote and the buyer VAT facts that decided it), channel (the sales channel), priceList / priceListName with priceListSource and pricingChain (each list reference carries deleted once that list is gone), and the discount code. Also: payment, fulfillment and delivery status, state, customer and company, shipping address, PO number, invoices and customFields. Ids other tools take: items[].id is the itemId of create_shipment and create_return; shipments[].id is the shipmentId of update_shipment; returns[].id is the returnId of approve_return, reject_return, receive_return, refund_return, complete_return and cancel_return. To find an order, list_orders.

orderId.description: The order's id (from list_orders), not its orderNumber
